message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Время прохождения паспортного контроля в аэропорту Дубая сократили до 3,4 секунды","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2,4,5]},{"claim":"В аэропорту Дубая внедрили обновленную систему умных ворот, которая позволяет зарегистрированным пассажирам проходить иммиграционный контроль всего за 3,4 секунды","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,4,5]},{"claim":"Технология использует биометрические данные, зарегистрированные при регистрации на рейс, чтобы ускорить проверку личности и сделать перемещение по аэропорту более удобным и быстрым","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3]},{"claim":"Система помогает снизить очереди и улучшить координацию служб в аэропорту","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Amazon стал первым онлайн-ритейлером на платформе Essential Goods Prices.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,11,19,27]},{"claim":"Министерство экономики и туризма ОАЭ и Amazon UAE подписали меморандум о сотрудничестве для повышения прозрачности цен и поддержки умных покупок.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5,9,10]},{"claim":"Теперь покупатели могут сравнивать цены на товары первой необходимости в 12 крупных магазинах и на Amazon.ae в одном месте.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,27]},{"claim":"Платформа отображает цены в реальном времени по 33 категориям товаров, включая 17 основных потребительских и 16 ключевых товаров.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,26]},{"claim":"Это первый случай интеграции онлайн-ритейлера в платформу, что расширяет возможности для сравнения цен между физическими и интернет-магазинами.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,11]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Ras Al Khaimah reopened seven public and resort beaches after nearly three weeks of closure due to oil spill concerns.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The reopened beaches include Flamingo Beach, Dahan Beach, Al Maireedh Beach, and Al Rams Corniche.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Beaches at three major resorts were also reopened.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The beach closures were ordered on October 24 as a precautionary measure after an oil spill from a tanker.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The oil leak was stopped on October 30, pollution declined, and cleanup and monitoring operations continue.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Authorities urge compliance with safety instructions and monitoring of official announcements.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В районе Аль-Фурджан в Дубае установлены платные парковочные зоны с кодом 591P.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Оплата действует с 8:00 до полуночи.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Доступна почасовая оплата и подписки.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Стоимость подписок: месяц — 672 дирхама, год — 4999 дирхамов.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Оплатить парковку можно через приложение Parkin, где также указаны тарифы и зоны.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"New UAE traffic regulations tighten vehicle recall and inspection rules starting from January 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Commercial agents are required to repair manufacturing defects free of charge.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,10]},{"claim":"Commercial agents must inform vehicle owners about recalls.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5]},{"claim":"Authorities can suspend transactions involving vehicles whose owners do not respond to recall notices.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7,8,9]},{"claim":"New requirements are introduced for technical inspection and updating vehicle owner data.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13,14,15,16]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Banks in the UAE began notifying customers about changes in service terms and tariffs effective from the beginning of 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4,5,11]},{"claim":"The new terms cover accounts, credit cards, loans, and digital services including the use of facial recognition for transaction verification.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,8]},{"claim":"Customers are advised to carefully review notices, especially sections on fees, digital authentication, and data use.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7,8,15]},{"claim":"The changes do not necessarily mean a mandatory increase in all tariffs; some updates concern only wording and procedures.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"KHDA представила единый каркас безопасности для частных учебных заведений, включая школы, детские центры и вузы.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,3]},{"claim":"В системе выделены три уровня риска угроз безопасности учащихся с разными процедурами реагирования.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,19,26]},{"claim":"В каждой школе создадут команду защиты, в которую войдут директор и минимум два ответственных сотрудника.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,14]},{"claim":"Они будут следить за случаями, координировать действия и взаимодействовать с властями.","supported":true,"evidence":[14,15,16,20,21]},{"claim":"Каркас основан на законе о правах ребёнка и поддерживает стратегию образования Дубая до 2033 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"2 и 3 декабря 2026 объявлены выходными в частном секторе ОАЭ","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Министерство человеческих ресурсов и эмиграции объявило, что среда и четверг, 2 и 3 декабря 2026 года, будут официальными оплачиваемыми выходными для всех сотрудников частного сектора в ОАЭ","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Это связано с празднованием 55-го Дня единства (Eid Al Etihad)","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Министерство поздравило руководство и жителей страны с этим событием","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"Emirates warned of delays with booking confirmation emails due to a global email outage.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Passengers should consider that emails may arrive with delay, but bookings remain secure.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The company asks passengers not to take any additional actions and apologizes for the inconvenience.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Музей Гуггенхайм в Абу-Даби откроется 11 декабря 2026 года","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Музей современного искусства площадью 80 000 кв. м станет крупнейшим Гуггенхаймом в мире","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"В нем будет 30 галерей и центральный атриум","supported":true,"evidence":[4,7]},{"claim":"Экспозиция охватит живопись, скульптуру, фотографию и новые медиа","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5]},{"claim":"Музей расположен на острове Саадият в культурном районе рядом с Лувром Абу-Даби","supported":true,"evidence":[18]},{"claim":"Вход для взрослых стоит 70 дирхамов","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"Дети до 18 лет, пожилые жители и некоторые категории посетителей проходят бесплатно или со скидками","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11,12,13,14,15,16]},{"claim":"Билеты можно забронировать заранее на официальном сайте музея","supported":true,"evidence":[17,18]}]}

{"supported":false,"reason":"The post contains a factual error in the name of the World's Best Pastry Chef and omits some details from the source; also, the post's claim about Antonio Bachour as 'world champion' is not supported by the source, which calls him 'World's Best Pastry Chef' and Guest of Honour, not a champion.","claims":[{"claim":"The fifth Salon du Chocolat will be held in Dubai from 30 November to 2 December.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The event will take place at Madinat Jumeirah.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The event coincides with the 55th Eid Al Etihad celebrations in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The exhibition will cover 3500 square meters.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The exhibition will feature 360 brands and 120 exhibitors.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"More than 50 pastry chefs will participate, including the world champion Antonio Bachour.","supported":false,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The program includes master classes, competitions, and a chocolate fashion show.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Residents of the UAE can obtain a criminal clearance certificate online through the Ministry of Interior portal or mobile app.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,19]},{"claim":"To apply, Emirates ID and a valid passport are required.","supported":true,"evidence":[15,19]},{"claim":"Citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council countries and visitors must undergo fingerprinting.","supported":true,"evidence":[16]},{"claim":"The certificate is issued in Arabic and English and is valid for 30 days.","supported":true,"evidence":[18]},{"claim":"The service fee is 50 dirhams for use within the country and 100 dirhams for use abroad.","supported":true,"evidence":[30]},{"claim":"The process takes 24 hours.","supported":true,"evidence":[29]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the UAE, a free online tool called StaySafe has been launched by the Cyber Security Council to check website reliability.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7]},{"claim":"Users can check a website using a color scale from red to dark green to determine the risk of fraud.","supported":true,"evidence":[14,15,16]},{"claim":"The service shows whether the website has been reported for phishing, whether it is officially registered, and how old it is.","supported":true,"evidence":[17]},{"claim":"StaySafe is available at staysafe.csc.gov.ae/en.","supported":true,"evidence":[12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) of the UAE warned about five signs of job fraud.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,5]},{"claim":"The five warning signs are requests to open a bank account, share bank details, pay for employment, use the account for transfers, and communication only via messaging apps without official channels.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,6,8,10,12,14]},{"claim":"The Ministry recommends verifying the employer through official channels and not sharing personal data before confirmation.","supported":true,"evidence":[9,11,13,15,16]},{"claim":"Contact options include call center 600590000, MOHRE UAE app, and website.","supported":true,"evidence":[17]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, in the UAE, heavy trucks and buses are prohibited from overtaking each other within cities.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4]},{"claim":"Outside cities, overtaking is allowed only if it does not obstruct traffic.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Drivers must follow six main requirements including driving on the right side, observing load and height limits, and prohibition on carrying passengers except workers if designated seats are available.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Cargo must be securely fastened and not extend beyond the vehicle's dimensions.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Minimum eyesight requirements are introduced for obtaining driving licenses for heavy vehicles and buses.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае запустили пятизвёздочную систему оценки такси","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Власти Дубая ввели новую систему рейтинга для компаний такси, чтобы повысить качество и эффективность услуг","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Оценка основана на четырёх ключевых направлениях и 18 показателях, включая экологичность, технологии, ответственность и надёжность","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6,7,8,9]},{"claim":"Компании с пятью звёздами получат семь новых таксометров","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Рейтинг будет отображаться на экранах в такси и у офисов компаний","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"В 2025 году в Дубае насчитывалось более 14 тысяч такси, из которых большинство — электромобили или гибриды","supported":true,"evidence":[10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Sharjah, a 320-meter-long bridge was opened as the first phase of the Al Dhaid Lake and Bridge project.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2]},{"claim":"The bridge is expanded to four lanes in each direction.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"The bridge has a capacity of up to 6,000 vehicles per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Under the bridge, a 2.3 km long lake was created with recreational zones, parks, and paths for pedestrians and cyclists.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The project includes flood protection measures and expands the green areas of the city.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In private educational institutions in Dubai, teachers are prohibited from using personal mobile phones, WhatsApp, and social media to communicate with students.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"All communications must take place through institutionally approved devices and platforms.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"These new rules are part of a safeguarding policy announced by the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA).","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The rules apply to all private educational institutions, including kindergartens, schools, and universities.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Дубай представил intelSPECT — инструмент на базе искусственного интеллекта, который анализирует отзывы клиентов на Google, чтобы выявлять риски пищевой безопасности на ранних стадиях.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,9,12]},{"claim":"Система помогает муниципалитету выявлять проблемные заведения и приоритетно проводить проверки, предотвращая возможные инциденты.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,6,7,15]},{"claim":"Инструмент учитывает жалобы на загрязнение, гигиену и пищевые отравления, а также оценивает реакцию бизнеса на замечания.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11,12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Prices on vegetables in the UAE fell by up to 42%.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2,3]},{"claim":"With the start of the local agricultural season in the UAE, prices on a number of vegetables decreased.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,7]},{"claim":"Zucchini prices fell from 12 to 6.95 dirhams per kilogram, a 42% decrease.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Prices also decreased for green pepper, cucumbers, and eggplants.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5]},{"claim":"Local farm produce increased supply in the market and expanded choices for buyers.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,8,9,10]},{"claim":"Price decreases are expected to continue in December 2026 and January 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[11,12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, UAE Cabinet Decision No. 174 of 2026 regulating heavy trucks and buses will come into force.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,6]},{"claim":"Truck drivers are prohibited from stopping in residential areas except for construction purposes.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"Truck and bus drivers must follow special overtaking rules and use designated lanes.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13]},{"claim":"Truck drivers must follow six main rules including load limits and prohibition of carrying passengers except employees.","supported":true,"evidence":[14,15,17,19]},{"claim":"Buses must have visible signs indicating authorized passenger capacity.","supported":true,"evidence":[28]},{"claim":"Buses must follow safety rules when transporting schoolchildren.","supported":true,"evidence":[38,39,40,41,42]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Eid Al Etihad holiday in Dubai is from 2 to 4 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The Dubai government announced the holiday for government entities from 2 to 4 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Official work will resume on 7 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The holiday does not apply to employees working shifts or in public services and utilities.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Each department will determine its working hours to ensure uninterrupted services.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, government fees can be paid in instalments through the Tamara platform integrated into the Dubai Payment System.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The instalment payment option depends on the transaction type and Tamara's terms and conditions.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"This integration expands payment options and supports the city's digital economy.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,8,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Вертипорт Dubai Marina получил официальную сертификацию для коммерческих полётов электрических воздушных такси.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Вертипорт способен обслуживать до 84 000 пассажиров в год.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Вертипорт способен обслуживать 21 000 посадок в год.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Маршрут соединит Dubai Marina с главным вертипортом у международного аэропорта Дубая.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Время поездки сократится с 35 минут на машине до менее 10 минут на воздушном такси.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Операции начнутся после получения всех разрешений.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}
